title: statusline r1 SA: settings.json probe is an unnamed trust boundary and parse surface
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 1. Lens: solution-architect (validator: solution-owner). Owner: SO session. comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree. Settings probe named in three places: Trust boundaries (new substrate settings file entry: schema-tolerant read, no write without confirmation, diagnostic-never-panic), effectful shell list (statusline offer's settings probe), fuzz scope (substrate-settings parser). Install bullet carries the conduct. Revision: Install bullet + Trust boundaries + effectful shell + fuzz scope.
